decisions.reason: The burner component draws directly on the firm's core gas-radiant engineering, is cheap to maintain within existing manufacturing and service, and supports the hydrogen-ready heater line, so there is little reason to withdraw it despite its low visibility.
The firm already pruned overlapping electric infrared lines in 2024, which concentrates its electrification know-how on this flagship panel range, where in-house R&D can keep improving it.

The hydrogen-capable dark infrared series is a strategic flagship with documented field operation, builds on decades of gas-radiant expertise, and matches the firm's low-carbon direction, so continued investment is near certain.
